name: DaFont
summary: Archive of 101,338 freely downloadable fonts, browsable by theme, new, top chart, author or popularity.
description: Font archive where each entry shows a preview, a style category (Script > Calligraphy, Fancy > Old School, Fancy > Retro …), the author, download counts and a licence note such as free for personal use, shareware, demo or public domain. Browse recently added fonts, themes, the top chart or authors; downloads are font files, some paired with a donate option. The site notes that the licence shown is only an indication and to check the readme files in the archives.
contains: browse by theme, new fonts, authors, top chart
per-font downloads counts and licence notes
style categories such as Script > Calligraphy and Fancy > Retro
install instructions for Windows and macOS
interface languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese
